subject: Renewal & expansion pricing — volume step-ups, blended rates, adding new routes/models
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: John Miller <john.miller@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-02-28T15:12:00-08:00
Subject: Post-call recap + ask: token volumes & target $/1M

Thanks for the call earlier today — great to meet the Acme Health team. Quick recap and a couple of asks so we can model renewal vs expansion pricing correctly:

- Current routes discussed: clinical note summarization (prod), triage assistant (pilot).
- Action for Acme: confirm current monthly token volumes per route and 6–12 month growth expectations.
- Pricing inputs we need: target $/1M tokens you'd like to hit for 1M, 10M, and 20M+ volumes; any fixed monthly budget or budget cap; preferred invoice cadence.

To make this concrete, it helps to know:
1) Current tokens/month (approx) for PROD routes
2) Expected additional tokens if new routes/models are onboarded (estimate for Q3)
3) Any hard budget range for inference spend (monthly or annual)

Next steps from us: I’ll draft two sample pricing structures — stepped volume discounts and a blended-rate example — and share with you and procurement by early next week. Can you confirm the token numbers and introduce procurement if they should be in the loop?

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachment: ACME_Renewal_Pricing_Sheet_v3.xlsx (pricing worksheet stub)

From: John Miller <john.miller@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@acmehealth.com>
Date: 2026-03-01T09:24:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + ask: token volumes & target $/1M

Thanks Marissa — quick answers below:

- Current PROD tokens: ~3,200,000 tokens/month across summarization + triage.
- Forecast with new routes/models (Q3): ~10M tokens/month (we're adding two additional summarization variants plus a routing model).
- Budget target: we were hoping to land around $700–$1,200 per 1M tokens, depending on SLA and support. If there are blended options, send examples.
- Procurement is looped for contracts and invoice cadence (they prefer monthly billing with a PO).

John Miller
Head of Product, Acme Health
john.miller@acmehealth.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: John Miller <john.miller@acmehealth.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-02T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Renewal + expansion pricing options (volume step-ups + blended example)

Hi John / procurement team — thanks for the numbers. Attached is a worksheet and an example SOW. Below are two suggested approaches based on your 3.2M current -> 10M forecast:

Option A — Step-up tiers (list pricing):
- 0–5M tokens: $1,500 / 1M tokens
- 5–20M tokens: $1,100 / 1M tokens
- 20M+ tokens: $750 / 1M tokens

Option B — Blended rate example (single $/1M for the whole volume):
- For 10M tokens: blended = ((5M * $1,500) + (5M * $1,100)) / 10M = $1,300 / 1M tokens (example)

Notes on structure and add-ons:
- If you add new routes/models we can either price them under the same token pool (preferred for simplicity) or as separate SKUs if you want strict cost accounting per route.
- We can include caps/alerts to avoid runaway spend and offer monthly invoice + PO compliance.
- Enterprise support / faster SLAs move the per-1M bands up (I’ve modeled both in the attached sheet).

Suggested next steps:
1) Procurement: confirm invoice cadence and PO process.
2) We (Redwood) to provide a redlineable renewal + addendum with volume step-ups and a blended-rate example for the 10M scenario.
3) Schedule a 30-min call with Dev (cc’d) to confirm SKU mapping for new routes if you want separate SKUs.

I’ve attached ACME_Renewal_Pricing_Sheet_v3.xlsx and a draft SOW. I’ll also generate a blended quote for your 10M forecast so you can see the unit economics and monthly spend.

Best,
Marissa

Attachments: ACME_Renewal_Pricing_Sheet_v3.xlsx; SOW-AcmeHealth.pdf

From: Procurement Team <procurement@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, John Miller <john.miller@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-04T08:42:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + expansion pricing options (volume step-ups + blended example)

Thanks Marissa — procurement questions:

- Can you clarify whether new routes/models will be billed from the same token pool (single PO) or will require separate line items (we prefer separate SKUs per BU)?
- What is the defined SKU/metric for "1M tokens" (do you round per-request, per-session? Need clear invoiceable metric).
- We require a spend cap and alerting; can Redwood support hard caps or will it be soft alerts only?
- DocuSign: please send the contract link when you have the redline-ready version; procurement reviews T+3 business days.

Procurement Team
procurement@acmehealth.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Procurement Team <procurement@acmehealth.com>, John Miller <john.miller@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-05T16:30:00-08:00
Subject: Next steps & delivery: redline + SKUs + cap options

Thanks — quick answers and next steps so we’re all aligned:

1) SKU / billing metric: Redwood bills on total consumed tokens per billing period (we’ll include per-route breakdowns on the invoice). We can also expose separate SKUs per route if you need line-item separation — Dev can scope the additional SKUs on the 30-min tech call.

2) Caps & alerts: we support configurable hard spend caps at the account level for Private/Dedicated customers and soft alerts for hosted accounts. For your contract we can add a hard cap with an auto-pause and notification flow (Procurement: confirm if you prefer auto-pause or manual review).

3) Pricing structure: I’ve attached the redlineable renewal + addendum that encodes the step-up bands and a blended-rate example for the 10M forecast. Example blended math included in the sheet.

4) DocuSign & timeline: uploading the redline-ready contract now — DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/en/documents/abc123 (same link in metadata). Please confirm PO cadence (monthly) and we’ll route the DocuSign to procurement.

Action items:
- Procurement: confirm auto-pause vs manual review for hard cap (reply to thread).
- John: confirm whether you want per-route SKUs or a single pooled token line item.
- Dev / Logan: please prep a 30-min technical scoping call for next Tue to define SKUs and integration steps.

I’ll follow up with a formal HubSpot quote and the DocuSign envelope once procurement confirms cap preference.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai
